definitions.gloss: musical piece (on a program), selection, track, program item
definitions.explanation: A piece of music as listed on a concert program, playlist, or album. Refers to the individual items in a musical performance or collection, rather than to a song in general.

examples.japanese: コンサートの{曲目|きょくもく}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the program of the concert.

examples.japanese: {演奏|えんそう}{曲目|きょくもく}はまだ{発表|はっぴょう}されていない。
examples.english: The performance selections have not been announced yet.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}のリサイタルの{曲目|きょくもく}には、ベートーベンとショパンの{作品|さくひん}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: Today's recital program includes works by Beethoven and Chopin.

notes:
USAGE:
{曲目|きょくもく} refers to specific pieces of music as items in a program, setlist, or collection. It is used when talking about what will be performed at a concert, what tracks are on an album, or what pieces a musician is preparing.

Compared to {曲|きょく} (song/piece), {曲目|きょくもく} emphasizes the piece as an item in a list or program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演奏|えんそう}{曲目|きょくもく}: performance program
- {曲目|きょくもく}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose the pieces
- {曲目|きょくもく}{一覧|いちらん}: list of pieces
- {曲目|きょくもく}{紹介|しょうかい}: introduction of the program
